field_checks.summary: Independent enumeration reviewed 38 activity records and found Table 2 represented with non-source-reviewable rows: nine records promote row labels such as Group 1-Group 9 as raw_value with target_species Indicator bacteria, 26 Table 2 target species retain a leading pipe, and 35 Table 2 rows use the generic endpoint table-reported antimicrobial measurement despite the source endpoint being inhibition circle diameter in mm.

The five DBAASP fallback candidate rows are preserved as unresolved_record with candidate_sequence null and candidate_sequence_length 0; no object containing both a plain sequence and sequence_length required residue reconciliation. No source_verified or authoritative ingest claim is made, but authoritative linked DBAASP/APD6/DRAMP rows are absent, so this remains a non-ingest-ready caution.

Core paper/packet final mirrors for activity, database, mechanism ontology, and review are byte-identical, packet mechanism_evidence is byte-identical to mechanism_ontology_record, and final counts match live objects: 38 activity, 4 toxicity, 5 database audits, 3 mechanism claims, and 0 review rework targets. The final directory file sets are not identical because materials_manifest is paper-only and mechanism_evidence is packet-only alias, so mirror parity is not perfectly clean.

The current mechanism ontology has three claims with evidence classes inferred_mechanism, phenotype_supported, and inferred_mechanism; no direct_mechanism claim remains and direct_assay_types are empty. The SDS/permeability wording is retained as discussion/inferred context rather than promoted to a direct membrane assay.

Toxicity records conflate the assayed entity and target with unsupported fields: the primary source describes bacteriocin P7 from B. velezensis G7 and domestic chicken erythrocytes/chicken blood, while all four toxicity records state LfcinB-derived peptide P7, N-terminal lipidation, and sheep red blood cells. Searches across source XML, extracted XML sections, and PDF text found zero Lfcin, sheep, lipidation, or N-terminal lipid mentions.

All checked locators resolve in locator_index, but locator presence does not make the row normalization valid. Final Table 2 rows assign mm units to Group labels and use header text as target species; these are placeholder-like fields not supported as measured activity values by the XML/PDF table surface.

Recursive authority is not asserted: strict acceptance and final database artifacts keep authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready false, fallback machine rows remain unresolved candidates, and linked authoritative row counts are zero. Fallback rows are therefore not eligible for RC2, portal, or authoritative ingest.

The p49 versus p57 hemolysis threshold discrepancy is preserved as a caution, and database fallback/non-authoritative status is preserved as a caution. These cautions do not repair the separate worker-2 source-field failures in the toxicity and Table 2 activity records.

The source directory contains only paper.xml, paper.pdf, and paper_meta.json; XML has no supplementary-material xrefs, supplementary_index files list no staged supplements, archive_manifest has no archives, supplementary text/table files are empty, and extraction_errors is empty.

The toxicity value coverage captures the p49 and p57 threshold/value locators, but the field-level science is not source-reviewable because every toxicity row assigns unsupported LfcinB-derived peptide P7, N-terminal lipidation, and sheep red blood cells instead of bacteriocin P7 and chicken erythrocytes/chicken blood from the paper.

blocking_findings.reason: Final activity/toxicity evidence is not publication-grade source-reviewable. Table 2 source surfaces show Group 1-Group 9 as fermentation-broth row labels and four indicator-bacteria species columns, but the final promotes nine group labels as raw_value with target_species Indicator bacteria, leaves 26 species values prefixed with a pipe, and uses a generic endpoint where inhibition circle diameter in mm is recoverable. The same final also conflates all toxicity rows with unsupported LfcinB-derived peptide P7, N-terminal lipidation, and sheep red blood cells, while the paper source supports bacteriocin P7 and domestic chicken erythrocytes/chicken blood.
required_actions: Re-open XML/PDF Table 2 and rebuild records so only numeric inhibition-zone cells become activity observations; do not emit observations for Group-label cells or header cells.

Normalize Table 2 endpoint to inhibition circle diameter, raw_unit mm, target_species without leading separators, and entity/scope to the correct CFS or fermentation-broth group with group-condition mapping from Table 1 when used.

Rebuild toxicity rows from p13, p27, p49, and p57: use bacteriocin P7 as the assayed entity, domestic chicken erythrocytes/chicken blood as the target material, and remove unsupported LfcinB, N-terminal lipidation, and sheep fields.
Preserve the p49 less-than-10 percent and 10.949 percent observations and the p57 less-than-5 percent discussion-level discrepancy with exact-vs-discussion status.
Refresh both paper and packet final activity_toxicity_evidence.json mirrors without promoting fallback DBAASP rows to authoritative ingest.
acceptance_checks: A script over both final activity_toxicity_evidence.json mirrors finds zero activity_records with raw_value matching ^Group [0-9]+$, zero target_species equal to Indicator bacteria, zero target_species beginning with |, and zero endpoint equal to table-reported antimicrobial measurement when source locator is xml:table-wrap:2.

The same script finds exactly 26 source-supported numeric Table 2 inhibition-zone observations or explicit source-backed exclusions for nonnumeric dash cells, all with raw_unit mm and target_species in Staphylococcus aureus, Listeria monocytogenes, Escherichia coli, or Pseudomonas aeruginosa.

A script over toxicity_records finds zero occurrences of LfcinB, sheep, lipidation, or N-terminal lipidation, and confirms bacteriocin P7 plus chicken erythrocyte/chicken blood context is supported by xml:p:13, xml:p:27, xml:p:49, and xml:p:57.

All activity/toxicity source_locators resolve in locator_index, paper and packet final mirrors are byte-identical, open rework ticket count remains equal to live packet state, and strict semantic/publication gates pass after the field-level checks above.

cautions.summary: Authoritative linked article, assay, literature, and sequence rows are all zero; five DBAASP machine rows remain unresolved fallback candidates and must stay excluded from RC2, portal, and authoritative ingest.

The source contains a results-level hemolysis threshold of less than 10 percent at MIC-2xMIC and a discussion-level less than 5 percent statement; this conflict is preserved and must remain explicit after worker-2 repair.

Core final mirrors are byte-identical, but full final file sets differ because paper final has materials_manifest.json and packet final has the mechanism_evidence.json alias. This is not the blocking scientific failure, but it prevents a clean file-set parity claim.
